g.text: Top: hollow circle = cal, filled square = audit; paired query-bootstrap 95% intervals (5000 resamples).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #45515c

g.text: Bottom: median and min–max of 5 serial single-thread plain-wall runs. One L, historical queries; not a frontier.
